# SM-17 — Files and uploads

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** The app accepts uploads or serves stored files.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
Magic-byte type check; size cap; storage outside the web root under random names.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-17-L1** A renamed binary is rejected; an oversize file is rejected; stored names are random and outside the web root. | auto | `test_report` |

## Full
Lite, plus archive-bomb limits and signed download URLs that expire in 15 minutes or less.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-17-F1** An archive bomb is refused; a download URL stops working after its expiry (≤ 15 min). | auto | `test_report` |
